title: TextMine: Data, Evaluation Framework and Ontology-guided LLM Pipeline for Humanitarian Mine Action
reasoning: The paper focuses on information extraction for humanitarian mine action (HMA). While it includes a brief section on ethical considerations regarding AI in demining, the core work is benchmarking the technical accuracy, hallucination rates, and position bias of LLM-generated triples from technical reports. It does not evaluate religion, morals, or ethics.
